name: Tabor Universal Sovereign System Integration
intent: System-wide universal reusable infrastructure without replacing distinct user-specified units

modules.contract: Namespaced identity, immutable source IDs, explicit ownership and permissions
Per-unit persistent memory with durable state and export/import contracts
Append-only hash chains, verifiable source references and verbatim preservation
Idempotent jobs, checkpoints, retries, dead-letter handling and replay controls
Event-driven scheduling with persisted due times; 1ms logical target not a wall-clock guarantee
Versioned HTTP, JSON Schema, MCP discovery and llms.txt metadata
Provider adapters for Cloudflare and independently tested self-hosted runtimes
Least-privilege service identities, explicit write grants, protected credentials
Logical CPU/RAM/storage profiles separated from physically allocated resources
Health receipts, structured logs, failure tracking and deployment verification
Encrypted snapshot and restore procedures with retention and restore tests
Human approval for destructive, financial, external publishing and deployment actions

domains.source: existing Cloudflare archive and library services
existing Cloudflare hub and service links

rollout.phase_2: Explicit adapters to existing Worker bindings and Durable Objects
rollout.phase_3: Bounded deployment to approved services with receipts
rollout.phase_4: Restore drills, provider portability testing, incremental expansion
